method: Started from 3,288 priced Kalshi legs in the next 36h. Kept legs priced 30–85¢ with edge ≥ −2.5 and no flags, at most one per game, and researched the strongest against today's 165 newly collected expert picks plus injury and goalie news. A leg stayed only if at least two of top-trader money, a published pick or model, and concrete news agreed, with nothing disagreeing. Dropped for conflicts: Chiefs −2.5 (Action Network has Falcons +3.5); Browns +3.5 and Bills/Jets (experts split); Suns +3.5 (top traders on the Suns, but Action Network and BetMGM have the Lakers); Raptors +4.5 (Dimers and Pickswise have Knicks −4.5); Seahawks/Raiders Over 40.5 (SI has the Under); Steelers/Bengals (experts split 4–4 on the side, and on the total too); Hawks ML (Covers and Dimers have Milwaukee); Thunder ML (Dimers has the Kings); Panthers/Stars (experts split). Monday games had almost no published previews yet, so the ladder runs Sunday afternoon to late Sunday night.
honest: Every leg costs slightly more than its fair price (edge −0.2 to −2.4¢ each), so expected return is slightly negative, and it gets worse with each leg you add.

ladder.label: Under 46.5
ladder.why: Covers' Neil Parker took Under 46.5: Jacksonville allows the second-fewest points per game and Tennessee plays slow and ranks 28th in scoring. Polymarket's top traders have about $11k on the Under and nothing on the Over.

ladder.label: Indianapolis Colts −3.5
ladder.why: Miami starts backup Kyle McCord, making his first career start, on the road. Five published picks back the Colts at -2.5 to -3.5 and none take Miami; Action Network's Doug Kezirian says the line should be near -6. Top-trader money leans Colts too.

sources.name: Action Network via Yahoo / Doug Kezirian (Colts -3.5)

ladder.label: Under 42.5
ladder.why: Pickswise expects a defensive battle with Green Bay missing Josh Jacobs, and Yahoo's Matt De Lima made the Under a 2-unit play. Top traders hold about $60k on the Under against $21k on the Over.

ladder.label: Oklahoma Sooners −1.5
ladder.why: The game was pushed to Sunday after an FAA ground stop kept Ole Miss in Oxford. Covers' top pick is OU -1.5: Ole Miss's defense was outgained 481-252 by Georgia, and Chambliss struggles under pressure. Pickswise and the Dimers model (57%) both back OU to win, and top-trader money is on Oklahoma only.

ladder.label: Edmonton Oilers
ladder.why: The BetMGM model gives Edmonton 58.8%, and the Oilers are 15-6 on the moneyline. Expected Flyers starter Dan Vladar has allowed three or more goals in each of his last five starts (.879). Top traders have about $3k on Edmonton and nothing against.

ladder.label: Indiana Pacers +5.5
ladder.why: Joel Embiid is out for Philadelphia, along with Bona, Barlow and Hukporti. TheSpread leans Pacers +7 because the net-rating gap doesn't justify the number without Embiid. Haliburton is also out for Indiana, so this is a lean. Top traders have about $4k on Indiana.

ladder.label: Iowa Hawkeyes
ladder.why: Two published picks lay the points with Iowa, at -3.5 and -4.5. Creighton is on its second straight road game, Iowa rebounds better, and Creighton leans heavily on Enis and Davis against a good Iowa defense. There is no top-trader money in this game.

sources.name: Action Network via Yahoo / Jonathan Jorcin (Iowa -3.5)

ladder.label: Under 44.5
ladder.why: Three experts took the Under at the lower 39.5-40.5 numbers, citing major offensive injuries on both sides, a slower pace, and Arizona's rookie QB behind weak pass protection. 44.5 gives five extra points of cushion, and top-trader money is Under only.

ladder.label: Vegas Golden Knights
ladder.why: Vancouver has lost seven straight and has the league's worst penalty kill, and likely starter Kevin Lankinen is 1-8 with a 6.03 GAA. Last Word On Sports predicts Vegas 5-2. Top traders lean Vegas, about $1.0k for to $0.2k against.

sources.name: Last Word On Sports / Marcus Yu (Vegas ML)
